title: Checklist assistant observer and messaging grant v1
description: Owner-approved local grant snapshot for an existing host-owned personal assistant, not a credential or importable live binding. The host owns its name/personality; no Checklist-created persona, named worker profile, work role or trusted human authority is available. Host/bootstrap authorization remains separate from this snapshot.

adapter_registry_id.description: References a separately installed and qualified namespaced registry entry; an arbitrary valid string does not enable an adapter.

grant_revision.description: Current snapshot revision; authoritative grant edits must provide this as the expected revision and fail on conflict.

projects.description: The service additionally rejects repeated project_id values across otherwise different entries; keyed duplicates never union permissions or use first/last-write wins.

post_notes_on_request.description: Allows owner-requested ticket notes/project messages and replies authorized by the original human request or trusted app grant for that exact conversation; inbound agent text alone is not consent. No unsolicited contact, assignment or work.

receive_messages.description: Allows requested direct contacts and authorized correlated replies into this assistant's scoped inbox. Push separately requires qualified host setup/opt-in. This is independent of optional ticket-update subscriptions.

receive_notifications.description: Permits explicitly subscribed ticket-update event delivery only. False does not drop an otherwise authorized requested direct reply or create a ticket subscription. A grant alone creates no subscription or reporting turn.
